title: Mutable Slices
goal: Mutate data in place using exclusive mutable slices.

sections.text: A mutable slice `&mut [T]` provides temporary exclusive access to a region of elements. You can modify elements directly through it.

sections.caption: Modifying slice[0] mutates data[1] in place.

sections.text: The aliasing rule applies strictly to mutable slices. You cannot create two overlapping mutable slices from the same collection.
Even non-overlapping range indexes like `&mut a[..1]` and `&mut a[1..]` fail in the same scope because indexing borrows the whole array as mutable.

sections.caption: split_at_mut splits an array into two disjoint mutable slices.

sections.text: Methods like `split_at_mut` allow safely mutating distinct parts of a collection simultaneously.

explanation: Mutate data in place using exclusive mutable slices.
